title: Ciphered colophon of the Strängnäs Sequentiarium, 1517, Uppsala UB C 513 f. 19v (DECODE R4349)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R4349 with the shared cookie: the only image is a placeholder icon; the attached PDF is two pages of the Uppsala C-collection catalogue describing C 513.
The catalogue entry states that the book is dated in secret script on f. 19v, each vowel replaced by the following consonant ('Annp dpmknk' = Anno domini), and prints the full reading.
Located f. 19v in the Alvin scans (attachment 42; attachment 40 is f. 18v) and downloaded the full TIFF.
Transcribed the four ciphered lines letter by letter (125 letters, 19 words with two line-end hyphens).
Applied the inverse shift, first word by word under the Latin model: k and x were misjudged because the model folds k into c, and prp came out as oro.
Fixed k=i and x=u (neither is a consonant in the text) and chose b/f/p by beam search over the whole colophon: the output matches the catalogue's reading word for word, prp = pro in context.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt, cipher letters (all 125 given a value)
outcome.notes: Read in the Uppsala catalogue (1992). Added here: the ciphertext transcription, the exact rule (u→x, consonant b/p two-valued), the folio's scan location, and DECODE corrections (not six symbols; date 1517; Latin; a colophon, not a letter).

prior.where: Uppsala C-collection catalogue Bd. 5 (1992), entry C 513, gives the rule and the full reading; the catalogue page is attached to the DECODE record itself

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
